section.game-flow.title: Game Flow
section.save-auto.title: Auto-Save
auto-save-enabled.label: Enable Auto-Save
auto-save-enabled.description: Automatically create save state snapshots at regular intervals during gameplay
auto-save-interval-seconds.label: Auto-Save Interval
auto-save-interval-seconds.description: How often to create an automatic save
auto-save-max-entries.label: Max Auto-Save Entries
auto-save-max-entries.description: Maximum number of auto-saves to keep (oldest are pruned)
save-on-quit.label: Save on Quit
save-on-quit.description: Automatically create a save state when you stop the game or close the app
section.save-shortcuts.title: Quick Save Shortcuts
enhanced-save-slot-shortcut.label: Enhanced Save Slot Shortcut
enhanced-save-slot-shortcut.description: Opens the save slot menu on shortcut press instead of immediately saving/loading
save-hold-duration.label: Hold to Save Duration
save-hold-duration.description: How long to hold the key to save (seconds)
section.turbo.title: Turbo
turbo-enabled.label: Turbo
turbo-enabled.description: Runs the game faster while the Turbo shortcut is held. Music keeps its tempo.
turbo-speed.label: Turbo Speed
turbo-speed.description: How much faster the game runs while the shortcut is held, from 1.25x up to 10x.
section.received-items.title: Received Items
quiet-rupees.label: Quiet Rupees
quiet-rupees.description: Randomizer rupees arrive without a message.
quiet-bombs.label: Quiet Bombs
quiet-bombs.description: Randomizer bombs arrive without a message.
quiet-arrows.label: Quiet Arrows
quiet-arrows.description: Randomizer arrows arrive without a message.
section.movement.title: Movement
turn-while-dashing.label: Turn While Dashing
turn-while-dashing.description: Change direction while using the Pegasus Boots dash
mirror-to-darkworld.label: Mirror to Dark World
mirror-to-darkworld.description: The Magic Mirror can warp you to the Dark World from the Light World
cancel-bird-travel.label: Cancel Bird Travel
cancel-bird-travel.description: Cancel duck flight in progress by pressing the X button
allow-diving.label: Allow Diving with Flippers
allow-diving.description: Press B while swimming to duck under for a moment, out of reach of anything that would hit you.
section.combat.title: Combat
collect-items-with-sword.label: Collect Items with Sword
collect-items-with-sword.description: Pick up hearts, rupees, and other items by slashing them with your sword
break-pots-with-sword.label: Break Pots with Sword
break-pots-with-sword.description: Level 2 or higher swords can break pots by slashing them
more-active-bombs.label: More Active Bombs
more-active-bombs.description: Place up to 4 active bombs at once
section.dialog.title: Dialog
section.dialog-pacing.title: Pacing
dialog-speed.label: Text Speed
dialog-speed.description: How fast text, pauses and scrolling play out: below Original slows typed lines, above it speeds everything, Instant skips the wait
dialog-hold-to-accelerate.label: Hold A to Accelerate
dialog-hold-to-accelerate.description: While A is held, dialog plays at the speed on the right
dialog-fill-on-b.label: B Completes the Box
dialog-fill-on-b.description: One press writes the whole box; the next press advances
dialog-typewriter.label: Type Letter by Letter
dialog-typewriter.description: Lines the game shows all at once type out one letter at a time, so Text Speed sets the typing rate
section.dialog-skipping.title: Skipping
auto-skip-dialog.label: Auto-Skip Dialog
auto-skip-dialog.description: Show dialog text instantly and dismiss message boxes for you, including item-get text. Yes/no and shop prompts still wait for your answer.
disable-telepathy.label: Disable Telepathic Messages
disable-telepathy.description: Suppress the princess's periodic telepathic pleas while walking to the castle in the rain
section.dialog-letters.title: Letters
extended-letters.label: Every Accented Letter
extended-letters.description: Dialog shows every accented letter a translation or a name uses, drawn in the game's own font. Off shows the plain letter instead.
language-screens.label: Screens Follow the Language
language-screens.description: Menus, pause text, ending and credits use the language too.
ja-file-select-style.label: Japanese file select style
ja-file-select-style.description: The file select screen uses the Japanese cartridge layout. Text still follows the language. Needs a Japanese ROM.
section.qol.title: Quality of Life
disable-low-health-beep.label: Disable Low Heart Beep
disable-low-health-beep.description: Silence the repeating warning beep when your health is low
skip-intro-on-keypress.label: Skip Intro on Keypress
skip-intro-on-keypress.description: Press any key to skip the intro and title screen sequence
show-max-items-in-yellow.label: Indicate Max Resources
show-max-items-in-yellow.description: Highlight rupees, bombs, and arrows in yellow when you're carrying the maximum amount
carry-more-rupees.label: Larger Wallet
carry-more-rupees.description: Increase the maximum rupee capacity from 999 to 9999
prefill-file-name.label: Prefill File Name
prefill-file-name.description: New files start named Link, with the cursor on End.
archery-needs-bow.label: Archery Game Asks For A Bow
archery-needs-bow.description: Stop the archery game from taking your money when you have nothing to shoot with; the owner tells you why instead.
map-on-select.label: Open Map with Select
map-on-select.description: Press the select button to open the map without going through the pause menu. Classic controls only.
section.cheats.title: Cheats
cheats-enabled.label: Enable Cheats
cheats-enabled.description: Master switch for every cheat: stats, items, combat and ignore collision.
section.tracker.title: Tracker
tracker-enabled.label: Enable Checks Tracker
tracker-enabled.description: Turning this off stops the checks tracker updating.
section.vanilla-safe.title: Vanilla Safe
vanilla-safe.label: Vanilla Safe
vanilla-safe.description: Forces off every feature, quality-of-life flag, bug fix, cheat, item override, custom player sprite and HUD override, so the game matches the original cartridge exactly. Harmless, low-risk divergences are included too; there are no exemptions.
